summary: Shared analytics wire events, user properties and ad impressions backed by Firebase Analytics.
manualSteps: In the consuming SKU only, download the Firebase Unity SDK 14.1.0 UPM tarballs com.google.firebase.app-14.1.0.tgz and com.google.firebase.analytics-14.1.0.tgz from the official Firebase Unity SDK distribution. Commit them under Packages/ManualSdk/ (Git LFS recommended). Do not import the unitypackage distribution as well.

Manually add com.google.firebase.app: file:ManualSdk/com.google.firebase.app-14.1.0.tgz and com.google.firebase.analytics: file:ManualSdk/com.google.firebase.analytics-14.1.0.tgz to the SKU Packages/manifest.json. Wizard Install writes the OpenUPM EDM4U 1.2.190 dependency only; it never downloads or adds tarballs.

Register matching Android/iOS app identifiers in Firebase Console. Download google-services.json (Android) and GoogleService-Info.plist (iOS) into Assets/ in the consuming SKU. Never use another project's service files.

Use Android minSdk 24 or later. Keep firebase_analytics_collection_enabled false and FIREBASE_ANALYTICS_COLLECTION_ENABLED NO; remove conflicting collection-on flags and do not set the permanent collection-deactivated flags.

Create FirebaseAnalyticsInstaller.asset through Framework/Modules/Create Installer Assets or the asset Create menu, then slot it on RootLifetimeScope in the Master Scene through the live Unity Editor.

For ad signals to be denied, configure analytics.firebase.adSignals = numeric 0 or string "0" before the first analytics work (numeric/string 1 enables it). Absent means granted. Native collection and dashboard delivery require device verification.
